name: bulk-action-bar
title: Bulk action bar
description: Appears when rows are selected: select all, the count and the actions, and one toast to undo the batch.

BulkActionBarRoot.description: The floating toolbar on its own: the parts go inside.

props.name: count
props.description: How many items are selected. The bar shows from 1 and hides at 0.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Empties the selection: the clear button, Escape and the checkbox (when all are selected) call it.

props.name: total
props.description: How many items there are in all, so the checkbox knows when all of them are selected.

props.name: onSelectAll
props.description: Selects every item. With it, the bar starts with a select-all Checkbox.

props.name: position
props.description: `sticky` sits after the content and sticks to the bottom of the screen while its container scrolls past; `absolute` lays it over the container's bottom edge (give the container `position: relative` and `pb-16`).

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description: Classes for the element that places the bar (sticky or absolute, centred).

BulkActionBarCount.description: The select-all Checkbox (when the root has `onSelectAll`) and "[3] selected", the number in a grey Badge. Other props, `ref` included, go to its `div`.

BulkActionBarClear.description: The clear button (×), at the end of the bar. Other props, `ref` included, go to the Button.

BulkActionBarSeparator.description: A thin rule between the count and the actions, and before the clear button. Other props, `ref` included, go to its `div`.

BulkActionBarAction.description: One action as a button in the bar. Other props, `ref` included, go to the Button.

BulkActionBarOverflow.description: The ⋯ button and its menu, for the actions that don't get a button. Other props, `ref` included, go to the ⋯ Button.

props.name: actions
props.description: The actions in the menu, in order.

BulkActionBar.description: The bar from props: the checkbox and the count, a rule, a button per action, the ⋯ menu, then a rule and the clear button. Other props, `ref` included, go to the toolbar element.

props.name: actions
props.description: The actions, as buttons after the count.

props.name: overflow
props.description: More actions, in a ⋯ menu after the buttons.
